# Forecast Calibration

> TypeScript binary forecast metrics: Brier score, log loss, ROC AUC, reliability diagrams, ECE and seeded day-block bootstrap intervals.

Package: @farhadarjmand/forecast-calibration. ESM, Node.js 22+, TypeScript declarations, MIT, zero runtime dependencies.
This file is a compact documentation map, not an assurance that any search engine or AI service indexes it.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/forecast-calibration/blob/main/README.md): installation, example, definitions and limitations.
- [API reference](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/forecast-calibration/blob/main/docs/API.md): exact input/output contracts and edge cases.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/forecast-calibration/blob/main/src/index.ts): public implementation and exported types.
- [Regression tests](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/forecast-calibration/blob/main/test/regression.test.mjs): independently reproduced edge cases.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/forecast-calibration/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release-specific behavior changes.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@farhadarjmand/forecast-calibration): installable releases.

## Constraints

Diagnostics do not train or recalibrate a model. They cannot detect data leakage, establish profitability, or certify calibration.
Examples and tests use synthetic data. No private datasets, credentials, trading service connections or training data are included. For reproducibility, use the installed package version's bundled docs, not changing main-branch documentation.
